title: summarize_entries — soft-fold messages into a summary (SegmentSummaryEntry)
description: Domain: session/message. Source: src/worker_rpc.rs:3858. When params.summary is omitted an LLM call generates it (falls back to a fixed Chinese placeholder on failure). Soft failures carry `error` in an otherwise-successful payload. Wire envelope (validated separately, not by this schema): worker replies {"id","type":"response","command","success":true,"data":<this payload>} (src/worker_rpc.rs output_response); host replies {"type":"response","id","success":true,"data":<this payload>,"session"?}. Errors use {"success":false,"error":string} with no data.

summary.description: Pre-written summary; empty/omitted triggers LLM summarization.
